Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing the Walla Walla state veterans' home.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to creating the Walla Walla state veterans' home;adding a new section to chapter 72.36 RCW; and providing a contingenteffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: There shall be established and maintained in this state a branch ofthe state soldiers' home, under the name of the "Walla Walla stateveterans' home," which shall be a home for veterans and their spouseswho meet admission requirements contained in RCW 72.36.030.

This act takes effect upon certification bythe director of the office of financial management that sufficient andspecific funding, referencing this act by bill or chapter number, hasbeen provided by June 30, 2012, in the omnibus capital appropriationsact for the state funds required by the United States department ofveterans affairs state home construction grant program for theconstruction of the state soldiers' home created in section 1 of thisact. A notice of certification must be filed with the code reviser for p. 1 HB 2719publication in the state register. If a certificate is not filed bythe director of the office of financial management by June 30, 2012,this act is null and void.
